title: Bryan Johnson reveals 11-year struggle with low iron
summary: Anti-aging influencer Bryan Johnson has disclosed that he has been suffering from low iron for 11 years. This revelation follows his earlier claim that his "stomach is eating itself." The condition he has been diagnosed with is autoimmune gastritis.
summary_points: Bryan Johnson revealed he has had low iron for 11 years.
He previously stated his "stomach is eating itself."
Johnson has been diagnosed with autoimmune gastritis.
The influencer is known for his anti-aging pursuits.

summary_points_hi: ब्रायन जॉनसन ने खुलासा किया कि वह 11 साल से कम आयरन से पीड़ित हैं।
